title: Answer
description:
Parents saw what the child was and refused the decree to destroy him.

He chose affliction with the people of God rather than the passing pleasures of a court. The reproach he bore was already the reproach of Christ. Egypt’s treasure was the thing he refused.

Blood on the houses was faith, not magic. The destroyer passed over because of the blood.

They passed through the sea as on dry land, the enemy behind them and the water on either side.

Walls fell by a word that was kept for the days commanded.

A woman of the city knew what her city would not hear, and she hid the spies. That knowing and that hiding were faith.
